title: Two defects found self-reviewing the first slice
result: Version/identifier queries no longer return nothing (`3.7.0`, `C#`, `GPT-5.3` become phrase queries), and the <120-char message filter was replaced by a confirmation-pattern filter — the old filter discarded 43.4% of real messages (the 26.4% figure came from the old chunked index, a category error); the new one discards 1.0%.
evidence: commit `2985c3a`; `tests/test_lexical_lanes.py` version test against a real index.
